transcription: Main article text only (site header and menus, the left 'AI RMF Development | NIST AI RMF Playbook | AI RMF Critical Infrastructure Profile | Engage | Resources | Perspectives | FAQs | AI @ NIST' section nav, the 'Quick Links' download block, the 'News & Updates' teasers, the 'Contact Us' email block and the footer removed). Whitespace normalised.
purpose: library: the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) — a voluntary framework for managing risk to individuals, organizations and society from AI, released January 26, 2023 through a consensus process (RFI, drafts, workshops), with its companion Playbook, Roadmap and Crosswalk, the Trustworthy and Responsible AI Resource Center (launched March 30, 2023), the Generative AI Profile NIST-AI-600-1 (July 26, 2024), the April 7, 2026 critical-infrastructure profile concept note, and the translations/prior-draft document trail. Fits step ordering of the release timeline, quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on dates and companion documents, and a concept map of AI RMF resources.
